walk_main_cm.basis: Common interior planning rule (Neufert, Architects' Data: main circulation about 90 cm).

walk_min_cm.basis: Common interior planning rule (a single person passing sideways needs about 60 cm).

sofa_table_gap_cm.basis: Common rule of thumb: 40 to 50 cm between a sofa and its coffee table, reachable while seated.

wall_margin_cm.basis: Our choice: 5 cm of play between a sofa and a side wall so it can be pushed in.

door_margin_cm.basis: Our choice: 2 cm of play when carrying an item through a door opening.

rug_under_sofa_cm.basis: Common styling rule: the front legs of the sofa stand on the rug, about 15 to 20 cm in.

rug_side_overhang_cm.he: השטיח בולט מכל צד של הספה
rug_side_overhang_cm.basis: Common styling rule: the rug extends 15 to 20 cm past each end of the sofa.

rug_wall_margin_cm.basis: Common styling rule seen in search answers (11.11.2026): 15 to 50 cm of floor between rug and wall; we use 30.

rug_sizes_cm.basis: The ready-made sizes sold in Israeli shops; 200 x 290 is priced in our data as "200 x 290 or so".

seat_width_cm.he: רוחב מקום לסועד ליד שולחן מלבני
seat_width_cm.basis: Neufert, Architects' Data: 60 cm of table edge per diner.

seat_round_cm.he: מקום לסועד על היקף שולחן עגול
seat_round_cm.basis: Rule of thumb: on a round table the place is measured on the edge, so a little more than 60 cm.

table_depth_cm.basis: Common dining-table depth 80 to 100 cm; we use 90.

chair_wall_cm.he: מקצה השולחן לקיר, בלי מעבר מאחור
chair_wall_cm.basis: NKBA Kitchen and Bath Planning Guidelines, seating clearance: 32 in (81 cm) when no traffic passes behind.

chair_edge_cm.basis: NKBA guidelines: 36 in (91 cm) to edge past a seated diner.

chair_walk_cm.basis: NKBA guidelines: 44 in (112 cm) to walk past a seated diner.

table_end_cm.basis: Rule of thumb: 60 cm at a table end with no seat there.

beds_cm.basis: The mattress sizes sold in Israel (single 90, youth 120, double 140, 160, 180).

bed_side_cm.basis: Common bedroom planning rule: 60 cm (50 at the least) beside a bed you get in from.

bed_foot_cm.basis: Common bedroom planning rule: 60 to 90 cm at the foot of the bed; we use 70.

wardrobe_front_hinged_cm.basis: Rule of thumb: an opening door (about 50 cm) plus a person standing.

wardrobe_front_sliding_cm.basis: Rule of thumb: a person standing in front of sliding doors.

lux.basis: Rule-of-thumb values inside the residential ranges of the IES Lighting Handbook (living 100 to 300 lx, kitchen and study tasks 300 to 500 lx).

kelvin.basis: The ranges the search answer for תכנון תאורה לבית showed on 11.11.2026 (2700K-3000K warm, 3000K-4000K neutral, 5000K cold) and lighting-shop guides.

lumen_factor.basis: Rule of thumb: lumens = lux x m2, plus 25% for light lost on walls and shades in a room with light walls.

fixtures_lm.basis: Typical catalogue output of LED fittings: 7 W spot about 600 lm, ceiling fitting about 2,000 lm, LED profile about 1,000 lm per metre, pendant about 1,200 lm. Check the box.

paint_cover_m2l.he: כמה מ"ר צובע ליטר בשכבה אחת
paint_cover_m2l.basis: Interior acrylic paint data sheets give about 8 to 12 m2 per litre per coat; we use 10. Check the can.

paint_coats.basis: Two coats is the usual repaint.

door_m2.basis: A standard interior door opening of 0.80 x 2.10 m = 1.68 m2.

paint_cans_l.basis: The can sizes sold in Israeli paint shops (18 l, 5 l, 1 l); some brands sell 4.5 l or 0.75 l.

waste_pct.basis: Installer rule of thumb: straight lay 5 to 10%, diagonal and herringbone 15% or more.

box_m2.basis: Usual pack sizes (60x60: 4 tiles, 80x80: 2 tiles, 120x120: 1 tile; plank packs about 2 to 2.4 m2). The exact figure is printed on the box.

contingency_pct.basis: Common budgeting rule of thumb (10 to 15%); no Israeli source chosen yet.

rooms_m2.basis: The size bands the search answers use with the designer-fee tables (3 rooms about 80, 4 about 100, 5 about 130 m2), seo/designer-market/architecture.md; 2 and 6 rooms are our extension.

kitchen_m_by_rooms.basis: Our default only, to open the example; the reader types the real run from the plan.

level_split.basis: The usual band of each item (or the full published range when no usual band exists) is split into three equal parts: basic = lowest third, mid = middle, high = top third.

service_split.basis: Designer fee bands run "from planning only to full supervision": planning only = lower half of the usual band, full supervision = upper half.

lift_stretcher_cm.basis: Israeli high-rise buildings must have a stretcher lift; its cabin is commonly 110 x 210 cm. Only an example: measure your own lift.

build_months_cbs.basis: CBS release 089/2026 (19.3.2026), buildings completed in 2025: 32.3 months per building, 37.8 weighted by flats.

steps.why: כדי שיספיק לתכנן לפני שהיזם סוגר את מועד השינויים.

steps.he: מגישים שינויים ליזם: קירות, חדרים רטובים, מטבח
steps.why: בשלב השלד והמחיצות. את המועד האחרון קובע החוזה עם היזם.

steps.he: תכנית חשמל ותאורה: נקודות, מפסקים, תקשורת
steps.why: הנקודות צריכות להיות בקירות לפני הטיח.
התעלות והניקוז נכנסים עם השינויים; היחידות אחרי קבלת המפתח.
זיכוי או שדרוג אצל היזם נבחרים עם השינויים.
מיקום הכיור, הגז והחשמל נקבע עם השינויים.
הזמנה כמה חודשים לפני המסירה, הרכבה אחרי קבלת המפתח.
לרהיטים בהזמנה יש זמן אספקה; מקבלים אותם אחרי המפתח.
בחודש האחרון, לפי מידות הנישות במטבח.
בסוף החודש ובקיץ המובילים יקרים יותר.
